SELECT DISTINCT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, SUM(anglers) as total_anglers, ROUND(SUM(yt)/SUM(anglers), 2) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips 
WHERE fish_date_doy >= 280 AND fish_date_doy <= 300
  AND cls = 'overnight'
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy
LIMIT 30

SELECT DISTINCT avail_season, avail_doy, fish_date_doy, 
  COUNT(*) as trip_count, SUM(yt) as total_yt
FROM trips 
WHERE avail_season = 2
GROUP BY avail_season, avail_doy, fish_date_doy
HAVING avail_doy > 235 AND avail_doy < 250
ORDER BY avail_doy DESC, fish_date_doy
LIMIT 20

SELECT fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)/SUM(anglers), 2) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE cls = 'overnight' AND fish_date_doy > 244
GROUP BY fish_date_doy
HAVING ROUND(SUM(yt)/SUM(anglers), 2) > 0.5
ORDER BY yt_per_angler DESC
LIMIT 30

SELECT fish_date_doy, boat, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  MAX(avail_t) as max_avail_t, MAX(avail_doy) as max_avail_doy
FROM trips
WHERE cls = 'overnight' AND fish_date_doy IN (288, 289, 290)
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, boat
ORDER BY fish_date_doy
